method_card.objective: Follow catalogue pages of an earlier query or reproduce a page from its saved bytes.
method_card.mechanism: Use one named search-snapshot.json and parameter action=next or replay. The snapshot supplies the exact query. Next requests the available provider cursors. Replay uses the archived responses offline.
method_card.estimator: Per-source page, returned count, hit count, continuation cursor and acquisition state; deduplicated publication identifiers on this page plus exact response bytes.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Public catalogue and original-source records; no trained model.

manifest.licence: GX release source. Original materials retain their respective licences.
manifest.licence_basis: Europe PMC and Crossref public metadata and Open Access JATS terms; intake records retain original source rights.
manifest.limitations: One bounded page per provider per Job. Coverage is per query and provider; unknown/missing continuation or a network failure cannot support a global scientific negative. Matching publications can share experiments and samples.
